traits.name: Steady
traits.blurb: Keeps a level head. The dead at the wall shake them 40% less.

traits.name: Nervous
traits.blurb: Jumpy. The dead at the wall shake them half again as much, and with six or more of them within ten tiles their aim is a tenth worse.

traits.name: Tinkerer
traits.blurb: Good with their hands. Mends walls 20% faster and makes ammo 10% faster.

traits.name: Triage
traits.blurb: Knows what to do first. Bandages 20% faster, and a cure is 5% more likely to work.

traits.name: Sharp-eyed
traits.blurb: Picks a target and hits it. Shots land 5% more often.

traits.name: Tough
traits.blurb: Shrugs it off. A claw or a bite is 15% less likely to leave a wound.

traits.name: Optimist
traits.blurb: Bounces back. Their spirits recover 30% faster.

traits.name: Loyal
traits.blurb: Stands by their people. Aims 3% better beside a friend, and takes a loss half again as hard.

traits.name: Quick learner
traits.blurb: Picks things up. Skills grow 30% faster.

traits.name: Coward
traits.blurb: Flinches. Shots land 8% less often, and when morale is low they leave the tower.

traits.name: Hothead
traits.blurb: Fires too soon and too often: 25% faster, and half again the ammo.

traits.name: Scrounger
traits.blurb: Finds more on a raid, and eats more at home.

traits.name: Thief
traits.blurb: Comes back from a raid with one thing extra. Now and then something goes missing.

traits.name: Veteran
traits.blurb: Seen it before. Shots land 10% more often, and the base is a little calmer for it.

traits.name: Pacifist
traits.blurb: Will not carry a gun. A pacifist cook or medic makes the kitchen or the infirmary worth 20% more to morale.
